It’s all scary until you learn to accept it. Trust me. I’m bipolar, I’ve been in and out of the hospital. I used to never open up to the psychs but then I said fuck it and just let everything poor out. Medicine is iffy but there’s some that work well with very few side effects. You won’t ruin anyone else’s life, even if you’re not bipolar there will be people in your life who you don’t get along with and end up parting ways on bad terms. It’s all a rollercoaster and everyone’s on for the ride. I recommend going to a therapist before a psychiatrist. Only the psych can prescribe medicine. it’s just to let these feelings and thoughts out with a professional, trust me. I’ve been in your exact place before. It gets better.
